'''HoloNet News CoCo District Edition''' was a [[HoloNet News/Legends|HoloNet News]] edition based on [[CoCo Town/Legends|CoCo Town]], [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]].

It contained the following segments:

*[[Business]]
*[[Regional]]
*[[Jedi Watch]]
*[[Sports]]
*[[Life (HoloNet News segment)|Life]]

It also contained a [[HoloNet News Weather Report|Weather Report]], a [[HoloNet News Lottery|Lottery]] section and a poll.
